zh: Dragon 浏览器网页端缩放改为真实页面缩放：菜单里的缩放现在让远端页面按 Chrome 同样的方式重排（50% 时一屏能看到更多内容），不再只是把截图缩小、在右侧和下方留出白边；缩放比例在切换网址后保留，可一键重置。
en: Dragon browser zoom on the web now zooms the real page: the menu zoom re-lays out the remote page the way Chrome does (50% shows more of the page), instead of shrinking the screenshot and leaving blank space on the right and bottom; the level persists across navigation and can be reset in one click.
